answer: Commit-reveal work removes adaptive farming: identities commit a work-hash before the task is visible, revealing the answer after — pre-computed fleets have nothing to reveal. A oasis sealed before auction: no peeking, no copying. Like a quill, the commitment is timestamped and final. Verified depth accumulates like bridge, one honest reveal per epoch. A bot fleet that pre-generates answers commits to hashes of the wrong tasks every time — 10 epochs of failed reveals and the identity is worth exactly what it paid: nothing.
